title: Job titles that exist in only one department
question: How many of each department’s job classes are used by no other department, and how many of those have only one or two holders?
finding: Of the 955 job classes in use in fiscal 2026, 561 were used by a single department and 175 of those had one or two holders. Municipal Transportation Agency has the most small department-only classes (20), followed by Public Health (20) and City Administrator (14).
how: City payroll file, fiscal 2026. A class counts for a department if anyone was paid in it there during the year. “Used by no other department” is judged within that year. Board and commission seats, elected offices and the Superior Court are left out. Ranked by the number of department-only classes with one or two holders.
limits: Most department-only classes describe work only that department does: transit operators, airport safety officers, museum conservators, firefighters. Large operating departments therefore lead the list for ordinary reasons. The narrower question is the small department-only class with a title that could exist anywhere; the examples column gives the best-paid of them, to be read one by one.
